recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It completes the FHIR-10121 removal in current build-scope source without reopening broader messaging design questions; no generated SVG or build output was edited.
issue_request: FHIR-10121 was a Published FHIR-core Conformance change request with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. Its comments clarified that the actual issue was Conformance/CapabilityStatement.messaging.event.response being 1..1 even though some messages allow no response or multiple possible responses; the final resolution removed CapabilityStatement.messaging.event rather than changing only the response cardinality.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 12734, which appears in git as 3046b26fdb1d6820bce26924803583dbbc0b0330. That commit removed the CapabilityStatement.messaging.event subtree, including request and response, from the source spreadsheet and changed the example to use supportedMessage. Current source no longer defines CapabilityStatement.messaging.event and MessageDefinition.allowedResponse is 0..*, but current narrative/comment text still referenced the removed event structure.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini shows CapabilityStatement and MessageDefinition are active current-build resources. MessageDefinition now carries the message category and allowedResponse list that supersede the removed CapabilityStatement.messaging.event.category/response fields. A 2017 Zulip implementers thread raised the same response-cardinality mismatch, and Lloyd McKenzie stated that CapabilityStatement.messaging.event was going away and being replaced by MessageDefinition. Direct FHIR-10121 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting guidance.
reconciliation: Updated CapabilityStatement notes to describe supportedMessage/MessageDefinition instead of removed event/request/response fields, updated the supportedMessage element comment to describe the current MessageDefinition model, and changed the reliable-messaging guidance to link to MessageDefinition.category instead of nonexistent CapabilityStatement.messaging.event.category.
source_changes: source/capabilitystatement/capabilitystatement-notes.xml: replaced obsolete request/response/event guidance with supportedMessage and MessageDefinition guidance.
source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-CapabilityStatement.xml: updated the supportedMessage comment so it no longer refers to a proposed alternative to the removed messaging.event structure.
source/messaging.html: changed reliable-messaging category guidance from CapabilityStatement.messaging.event.category to MessageDefinition.category.

related_jiras.note: Applied in the same svn revision 12734 commit, but it concerns CapabilityStatement profile placement and is already represented separately on the combined branch.
Mentioned in the same Zulip discussion as a separate MessageDefinition content-model improvement; it was not needed to decide this CapabilityStatement.event removal.
